title: C# Quick Reference
description: Find a word or command you have seen in a lesson. Each short note tells you what it does. Open the linked lesson for the full example.

entries.name: Console.WriteLine
entries.summary: Print a value and move to a new line.

entries.name: dotnet new
entries.summary: Make the starting files for a console project.

entries.name: dotnet run
entries.summary: Build and run the project in the current folder.

entries.name: int
entries.summary: Keep a whole number in a named variable.

entries.name: string
entries.summary: Keep text such as a name or a message.

entries.name: int?
entries.summary: Keep an integer or null when no value is present.

entries.name: if
entries.summary: Choose a step by checking a true-or-false rule.

entries.name: for
entries.summary: Repeat a block while a condition is true.

entries.name: Method
entries.summary: Give a set of actions a name.

entries.name: Named argument
entries.summary: Label an input by its parameter name.

entries.name: class
entries.summary: A plan for objects with their own data and actions.
entries.syntax: class Book { public string Title { get; set; } = ""; }

entries.name: Property
entries.summary: A named way to read or set object data.
entries.syntax: public int Score { get; private set; }

entries.name: record
entries.summary: A type that compares its stored values by default.

entries.name: interface
entries.summary: A list of actions a class promises to supply.

entries.name: override
entries.summary: Replace a virtual action inherited from a parent.

entries.name: List<T>
entries.summary: Keep a list of values that can grow.

entries.name: Where
entries.summary: Keep only items that match a rule.

entries.name: Select
entries.summary: Make a new value from each item in a group.

entries.name: OrderByDescending
entries.summary: Put the largest values first.

entries.name: ToList
entries.summary: Read a query and collect the results into a list.

entries.name: try / catch
entries.summary: Try an action and handle a matching error.

entries.name: finally
entries.summary: Run cleanup after try and any matching catch.

entries.name: JsonSerializer.Serialize
entries.summary: Turn a value into JSON text.

entries.name: await
entries.summary: Wait for an async operation and read its result.

entries.name: [Theory]
entries.summary: Run one test rule with several sets of inputs.
